# Jane Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c28 P40](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0040), [v2 c9 P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Jane is described as plain.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Jane is plain, plodding, conscientious, and practical. She possesses calm, steady nerves that prevent her from getting rattled during stressful situations like examinations. While she is impressed by high society, fine clothes, and luxury items, her outlook on life and teaching remains straightforward and pragmatic. She is opinionated about propriety and marriage, and is determined to keep order in her classroom by being firm.

_Sources: [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c30 P36](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0036), [v1 c31 P30](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0030), [v1 c33 P47](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0047), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002)_

## History

While out on a boat ride on the Lake of Shining Waters with her father, Jane nearly fell overboard picking water lilies but was caught by her sash in time. At school, she gamely accepted a dare from Josie Pye to hop on one leg around the garden, stopping at the third corner. She prepared a dialogue called 'A Morning Visit' with Diana Barry and Ruby Gillis for Miss Stacy's Friday afternoon recitations. Jane later attended Queen's Academy to study for her teaching license, carrying off top honors in the domestic science course. After graduating, she accepted a teaching post at Newbridge School and joined the Avonlea Village Improvement Society, where she was appointed chairman of the hall re-shingling and painting committee.

_Sources: [v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c6 P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010)_
